newsitem.title: USA: Hugoton Energy cancels stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Hugoton Energy cancels stock offering.

text.p: Hugoton Energy Corp said Friday it has withdrawn its registration statement covering the proposed sale of shares of its common stock by the company and certain selling shareholders due to unfavorable market conditions.
The company had filed in February to offer six million shares, including 1.5 million offered by the company.
Odyssey Partners, LP, and several limited partnerships managed by First Reserve Corp, were offering the other 4.5 million shares.
The company had planned to use the proceeds to repay a portion of its outstanding bank debt.
